pr_title: Fix file order issue with base and enumerated file-names
pr_body:
fix #99235

Added a `.` check before digits' check makes file name sporting put base name before enumerated ones (`name.ext` before `name1.ext`).
pr_comments:
I noticed another weird ordering:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/da8b3c42-53c8-4efe-92d2-09ce2ee9ae10)

Expected:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/88dc1ae2-33f8-4885-bb14-ee8bd7f51229)

Although GIMP orders it in an even different way, so I guess it's arguable:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7f2314b6-27c8-4854-9e53-e99e64d93a42)
I realized this change should probably go to `filecasecmp_to` instead.

> I realized this change should probably go to `filecasecmp_to` instead.

This is deeply linked to digits sorting which is in `naturalnocasecmp_to_base`.

We could do some preemptive checks to see if there is a `.` on divergence in files but I do believe it's more "natural" sorting that way even if its not on files.
Something that could be extended is to include other characters than '.' for more case handling like `name_1_01` and `name_11_01`.
Superseded by #104440. Thanks for the contribution!
